description: NHFLOW explicit (A 510 2, A 520 2) with wetting and drying in a closed square basin that is symmetric about the diagonal x = y: a beach 1:8.3 rising along the diagonal to dry land, an island on the diagonal (1.5 m above the water), a square of water raised by 0.5 m in the near corner, bed smoothing A 509 1. The gauges come in pairs (x,y), (y,x): the two of a pair read the same to 1e-7 m since the band of the deep flags is 2 cells in y as in x (3 cells in y gave 1.6e-2 m).
covers: nhflow_fsf_f::wetdry: band of the deep flags in x and y
avoid isolated wetdry from a copy of the flags
nhflow_f::ini: bed smoothing from the old values (A 509)
